name: Ring of Free Action

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: Difficult Terrain doesn't slow you, and magic can't reduce your speed or make you Paralyzed or Restrained.
text: Wearing this ring, you spend no extra movement for Difficult Terrain, and no magic can lower any of your Speeds or inflict the Paralyzed or Restrained condition on you.
